name: calibry
description: Find current job openings from employer career sites in any profession, read full postings, and compare them to the experience you share. Optionally save your background on Calibry, with your consent, to build a tailored resume.

interface.longDescription: Find current job openings from employer career sites in any profession, read full postings, and compare them to the experience you share. Optionally save your background on Calibry, with your consent, to build a tailored resume.
defaultPrompt: Find registered nurse jobs in Austin, Texas.
Find sales manager roles near Chicago.

positive.description: Find nursing openings in a city.
positive.prompt: Find registered nurse jobs in Austin, Texas.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists registered nurse openings in Austin with title, employer, location and a link to each opening on Calibry.

positive.description: Find remote roles in a non-technical field.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists remote accountant and accounting openings with a link to each opening on Calibry.

positive.description: Rank openings against a short background summary.
positive.prompt: I have 8 years of warehouse operations experience and I am a team lead. Find supervisor jobs near Columbus, Ohio.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches supervisor and warehouse openings near Columbus, passing a short summary of the stated background, and lists the closest matches.

positive.description: Read a full posting and compare it to stated experience.
positive.prompt: Open the first sales manager job you found and tell me how my experience compares. I managed a team of 6 reps and exceeded quota three years in a row.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the full posting, quotes its requirements, and compares only the experience the user stated, listing which requirements are not covered, without a match percentage.

positive.description: Save a background and continue on Calibry after consent.
positive.prompt: Save my background so I can build a tailored resume for that role.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the consent text with links to the Privacy Policy and Terms, asks for a clear yes, and only after the user agrees saves the details and returns a link to continue on Calibry.

negative.description: Pay research, which this plugin does not provide.
negative.prompt: What is the average pay for a registered nurse in Texas?

negative.description: Sending messages or submitting applications for the user.
negative.prompt: Email the hiring manager at that hospital and submit my application for me.

negative.description: Travel and logistics unrelated to finding a job.
negative.prompt: Book a hotel and a flight for my interview next week.
